title: pr-brief configuration
description: The only three settings. Everything else is a fixed convention.

style.description: How prose is edited. ste+iceberg runs asd-ste100 then iceberg. ste runs asd-ste100. iceberg runs iceberg only.

previous.description: What `improve` does with the earlier human description. drop replaces it. comment keeps it as a hidden HTML comment.

theme.description: A built-in theme, or a path to a theme JSON file (see pr-brief-theme.schema.json). The path is relative to the config file that sets it. In a repo config it must stay inside the repo.
